create.heading: New poll
create.title: Title
create.optionsHelp: Add at least two candidate times. Adding the same time twice merges it into one option.
create.defaults: Defaults: 4 minimum, 4 maximum, 2 hours, 24-hour deadline, no platform, not private.
create.steamAppIdHelp: Optional. The number in the game's Steam store URL, e.g. 730 for Counter-Strike 2.

gamePicker.label: Search the Steam catalog
gamePicker.placeholder: Search or type a game name
gamePicker.noResults: No matches. Your typed name will still be used.

grid.heading: Candidate start times
grid.hint: Tap a time to add it. Drag a band to move it, or drag its handle to change the duration of every candidate.
grid.resizeDuration: Drag to change the duration of every candidate

validation.range: Enter a value in the allowed range.
validation.minMax: Minimum attendance cannot exceed maximum capacity.
validation.invitedFriend: A non-private poll needs at least one invited friend.
validation.tooManyInvitees: You can invite up to 50 friends.
validation.tooManyGuestLinks: You can create up to 20 guest links.
validation.optionMinimum: Add at least two candidate times.
validation.optionCap: A poll can have at most 12 candidate times.
validation.steamAppIdDigits: Enter only the numeric Steam app ID.
validation.steamAppIdNeedsGameName: Enter a game name to go with the Steam app ID.

list.heading: Polls
list.description: Vote on candidate times, then finalize the winner into a session.
list.emptyDiscoverable: No open polls to discover right now.

detail.noVoteYet: You have not voted on this option yet.

suggest.heading: Suggest a time
suggest.optionCap: This poll already has 12 candidate times — the most it can hold.

prefill.pollTruncated: Only the first {{max}} candidate times from your selection were kept — a poll can have at most {{max}}.

mute.copy: Muting suppresses everything about this poll except your reminder while your vote is Available or Maybe. Unmuting does not backfill — nothing missed while muted is queued to deliver later.
mute.disabledTerminal: Muting is not available once a poll is finalized, expired, or canceled. For a finalized poll, mute the session it created instead.

leave.help: Leaving withdraws your votes. You are not banned — you can be invited again or ask to join.

finalize.earlyNotice: Enough people are available for at least one time. Finalizing now ends voting immediately and creates the session.
finalize.previewGuarantee: This preview and finalizing use the same rule — the same inputs always produce the same result. If something changes in between (an option is removed, or someone's access changes), the outcome may differ from what's shown here.
finalize.confirmBody: This creates a session at {{time}} and cannot be undone.
finalize.confirmBodyEarly: This closes voting right now and creates a session at {{time}}. It cannot be undone.

cancel.title: Cancel this poll?
cancel.body: This cannot be undone. Guests lose access to this poll immediately, and their invitation links stop working.

guests.heading: Guest links
guests.removeConfirm: This removes their votes and revokes their link. This cannot be undone.

guestPoll.expired: This poll's selection window has closed.
guestPoll.finalized: This poll was finalized. Re-open your invitation link for the session.

dirty.title: Discard unsaved changes?
dirty.body: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, they will be lost.

codes.poll_not_found: That poll could not be found.
codes.poll_validation: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
codes.poll_option_cap: A poll can have at most 12 candidate times.
codes.poll_option_not_found: That option could not be found.
codes.poll_voting_closed: Voting has closed for this poll.
codes.poll_terminal: This poll can no longer be changed.
codes.poll_invalid_transition: That change is no longer possible.
codes.poll_invites_closed: This poll is no longer accepting invitations.
codes.poll_participant_removed: You no longer have access to this poll.
codes.poll_conflict: This guest has already claimed their link and can't be revoked. Remove the guest instead.
codes.poll_guest_not_found: That guest could not be found.
codes.poll_selection_window_closed: The selection window for this poll has closed.
codes.poll_zero_options: This poll has no remaining options.
codes.poll_guest_link_not_found: That invitation link could not be found.
codes.poll_guest_link_inactive: That invitation link is no longer active.
codes.guest_link_not_claimed: Join this poll with your name before voting.
codes.guest_link_terminal: This invitation link is no longer active.
codes.user_not_found: That user could not be found.
codes.invalid_scope: That poll list is not valid.
codes.invalid_cursor: That page of results is no longer valid.
codes.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again later.

a11y.validationSummary: There were problems with your submission
a11y.candidateBand: Candidate {{day}} {{range}}. Enter removes it, arrow keys move it, Shift with arrow keys changes the shared duration.
a11y.candidateCapReached: You already have the maximum of {{max}} candidate times.

polls.body: No polls yet. Start one and let everyone pick a time that works.

countdown.pickWindow: Organizer has {{time}} of the 48h window left to pick
countdown.expiredBanner: Expired — the 48h picking window passed without a choice.
countdown.canceledBanner: Cancelled by the organizer. Votes are kept for reference.

detailLovable.deleteOptionBody: Everyone's votes on this time are removed. Other options are untouched.
detailLovable.belowMinimumNotice: Below the minimum of {{min}} players — you can still finalize.
detailLovable.suggestDialogHelp: It becomes an option straight away — no approval needed.
detailLovable.nudgeNotice: Everyone gets a nudge to vote on the new option.
detailLovable.candidateHint: Ranked by Available, then Maybe. Vote on every option.
